def solve():
    n = int(input())
    g = [[] for _ in range(n+1))]
    for i in range(n-1):
        u,v = map(int,input().split()))
        g[u].append(v)
        g[v].append(u)

    def dfs(cur,p):
        if cur == p:
            return []
        res = [cur]
        for nxt in g[cur]:
            if nxt != p:
                res += dfs(nxt,cur)
                break
        return res
    
    ans = 0
    for i in range(1,n+1)):
        for j in range(i+1,n+1)):
            for k in range(j+1,n+1)):
                s1,s2,s3 = set(),set(),set()
                s1.update(dfs(i,j)))
                s1.update(dfs(i,k)))
                s1.update(dfs(k,i)))
                s2.update(dfs(j,i)))
                s2.update(dfs(j,k)))
                s2.update(dfs(k,j)))
                s3.update(dfs(k,i)))
                s3.update(dfs(k,j)))
                s3.update(dfs(j,k)))
                ans = max(ans,len(s1)),len(s2)),len(s3))
    
    print(ans)
    print(*sorted([i for i in range(1,n+1))]))
    

solve()

            ans=min(ans,dfs(k,i)+dfs(k,j)))
        dp[i][j]=ans
        return ans
